To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

preamble sampling MAC protocols are the most energy-efficient protocols for WSNs and that there is no single best MAC protocol for all WSN applications, but the most suitable MAC category depends on the application.

the most relevant MAC protocols for WSNs can be classified in three categories according to their operation, and that the selection of the best protocol for a given application depends on the characteristics of the application.

the MAC protocol design for WSNs can be categorized into four main categories: Contention based MAC protocols, TDMA based MAC protocols, Preamble sampling based MAC protocols and Hybrid MAC protocols.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, analysis and optimization of communication networks and systems.
the design and implementation of low energy MAC protocols for WSNs.
the design of low power MAC protocols that are able to support a wide variety of applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the preamble sampling MAC protocols are not a good solution for all WSN applications.
the MAC protocols designed for low energy operation in WNs are not yet mature, and there are still many challenges and open issues to be solved.
the MAC protocol design for WSNs should be application-dependent and that there are no MAC protocols designed for all WSNs, as it was initially believed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have surveyed the state of the art of MAC protocols in WSNs, with special focus on preamble-sampling MAC protocols.
the preamble sampling techniques are very suitable for WSNs.
we have surveyed the most relevant MAC protocols for WSNs and we have provided a classification and guidelines for selecting the most suitable MAC protocols for a given WSN application.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design of MAC protocols for WSNs must be tailored to the application requirements.
there is no such thing as the best MAC protocol for WSNs.
there is no such thing as a one-size-fits-all MAC protocol.
